title: How Effective Is Geo-Fencing for Local Advertising? Benefits, ROI & Real Examples

facts.fact: According to the page, a geo-fenced user can receive targeted messages wherever they go for 30 days after entering the geo-fenced area, not only while at that location.
facts.quote: not only when they’re at the geo-fenced location but wherever they go over the next 30 days.

facts.fact: The page states that geo-fencing can segment audiences for local advertising down to the zip code level.
facts.quote: all the way down to the zip code level.

facts.fact: The page cites unnamed studies claiming that businesses using geo-fencing in some campaigns and industries see conversion rates up to 20% or even 30% higher than those relying only on traditional ads.
facts.quote: businesses using geo-fencing can see conversion rates up to 20% or even 30% higher than those relying only on traditional ads.

facts.fact: The page reports that some restaurant campaigns reported around 20–30% lifts in visits after introducing geo-fencing offers; the page gives no named source for this figure.
facts.quote: some restaurant campaigns have reported around 20–30% lifts in visits after introducing geo-fencing offers

facts.fact: The article was published on March 5, 2026.
Some reports and case studies from the past few years show double-digit percentage increases in local sales or store visits when geo-fencing is added to the marketing mix, though results vary.
facts.quote: Some reports and case studies from the past few years show double‑digit percentage increases in local sales or store visits when geo-fencing is added to the marketing mix

facts.fact: West Coast Media, the agency publishing the page, is based in El Dorado Hills, CA.
facts.quote: West Coast Media is a full circle digital marketing agency based in El Dorado Hills, CA.
